title: Parametric objects
subtitle: Parametric desktop objects
short: Exploring desktop objects through branching forms and continuous surfaces.
intro: Rhino and Grasshopper generate complex forms that are difficult to construct through conventional modelling. Variations in branching, openings and continuous surfaces explore desktop objects and their expression through 3D printing.
